before: Actual request fields may be absent or arrays rather than strings. This pure function first checks the minutes field is a String, then validates an integer from 1 through 60 using the filter extension. Treating all request values as trustworthy scalars can cause type errors or bypass intended rules.

The return value explicitly contains status, headers and body. The CLI fixture inspects that contract only: it does not call header(), emit a browser response or verify a server adapter. A web adapter must apply status and headers before body output; authentication and CSRF checks are additional concerns.

Expected output or behavior: 200
{"minutes":15}. Compiler evidence is recorded separately from app reading completion.
